scope: Current phone-app source catalogue; this inventory does not certify game testing or provide public game servers.

games.description: Hop over your opponent's pieces and take them. Reach the far row for a king.
games.howToPlay: Move diagonally, jump opposing pieces and reach the far side to promote a piece. The game highlights legal moves.
games.mode: Local host-phone option and campsite play
games.verification: Implementation catalogued; individual device checks pending

games.description: The full game, with a computer opponent at three levels and an optional clock.
games.howToPlay: Select a piece to see its legal moves. Protect your king and work toward checkmate.

games.verification: Implementation catalogued; individual device checks pending

games.description: Match the numbers on the ends of the line. First to use up all your dominoes wins.

games.description: Draw lines, close boxes, and take another turn when you do.

games.description: Drop a counter, line up four. Two players; everyone else can watch.
